name: EgoBody
tagline: 125 two-person sequences, 36 subjects, 15 scanned indoor scenes: HoloLens2 ego view + 3-5 Kinects with SMPL-X bodies for both people.

annotations.format: PKL (SMPL-X / SMPL params per frame), NPZ (2D keypoints), CSV (sequence info, gaze), JSON (calibration), OBJ (scenes)
annotations.coverageNote: Every sequence has SMPL-X fits for interactee and camera wearer (219,731 Kinect + 199,111 ego frames); gaze/hand/head tracking from HoloLens2.

object_boxes.note: Person crop box (center, scale) per ego frame in keypoints.npz

hand_pose.note: SMPL-X hand articulation; HoloLens2 hand tracking in head_hand_eye.csv

body_pose.note: SMPL-X and SMPL params per frame for both people; OpenPose BODY_25 2D joints

camera_pose.note: Per-frame PV camera-to-world transform; Kinect/HoloLens extrinsics

depth.note: Kinect depth PNGs (3rd person) and HoloLens2 depth stream

scene_3d.note: Textured OBJ mesh for each of the 15 scenes

qa_language.note: Motion text descriptions via Motion-X (separate license)

annotations.sample:
# data_info_release.csv (one row per sequence)
recording_name,body_idx_0,body_idx_1,body_idx_fpv,start_frame,end_frame,scene_name
recording_202xxxxx_Sxx_Sxx_xx,<gender of body 0>,<gender of body 1>,<interactee idx+gender>,<int>,<int>,<scene>

# smplx_interactee_train/RECORDING_NAME/body_idx_x/results/frame_xxxxx/000.pkl
{"transl": [...], "global_orient": [...], "betas": [...], "body_pose": [...]}  # SMPL-X params, master-Kinect frame

samples.caption: Egocentric views with fitted SMPL-X bodies of the interactee and camera wearer
